title: The Drowned Spire
author: Paloma Crane
blurb: Wren Thornbury, a debt-bound temple scribe, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
